# NCAAF Saturday - Nov 7

Covers AI (Kalshi lines) vs Dimers win probabilities vs Kalshi. Dimers' listed spreads are openers; current lines used below.
- Iowa at Northwestern: opened NW -2.5; Covers AI Iowa 21-20, Dimers Iowa 55.8%, Predictem Iowa 21-17 - but the market flipped to Iowa ~56% (Kalshi), so the edge is gone. Pass.
- Miami at Notre Dame: ND -3.5 -> -7 after Miami WR Malachi Toney (1,027 yds, 13 TD) went out. Covers AI ND by 6, Dimers 72% (~7.5). On the number; pass.
- Oregon at Ohio State: OSU opened -14, now -7.5. Covers AI OSU by 14, Dimers 74.5% (~9) - both favor OSU but laying -7.5 is the hook through 7. Pass.
- Alabama at LSU (-5.5/-6.5): Covers AI LSU by 4, Dimers ~6, Kalshi "LSU by 6.5+" 49%. Alabama QB Jett Thomalla doubtful (backup-QB dog). Pass.
- Oklahoma at Florida (-6.5): Covers AI FLA by 3, Dimers ~6, Kalshi "FLA by 5.5+" 52%. OU QB Mateer possible benching, eight players out. Pass.
- BYU at Utah (-3.5/-4.5): Covers AI Utah by 11, Dimers ~4.5 - Utah -3.5 is the hook through 3. Pass.
- Georgia at Ole Miss (+3.5): Covers AI UGA by 1, Dimers ~3.5-4. Lean Ole Miss +3.5 only.
- Texas at Missouri, Kentucky at Tennessee, UCLA at Minnesota, Houston, Texas Tech, Boise: Covers AI and Dimers split or on the number. Pass.
No bets.
